# Twin Towers by Defoy

> A 25-room hotel on the road to Pahalgam, in Dehwathu, Jammu & Kashmir, India. Part of Defoy Hotels & Resorts.

Core brand line: "Stay closer to what matters. A quieter kind of escape in Kashmir."

## Property facts

- Name: Twin Towers by Defoy
- Parent brand: Defoy Hotels & Resorts
- Location: Dehwathu, on the road to Pahalgam, Jammu & Kashmir — 192401, India
- Coordinates: 33.92305759663491, 75.27313041534288
- Elevation: 2,200 metres
- Total rooms: 25 (one category: Premium Room with Balcony)
- Starting rate: INR 5,000 per night
- Check-in: 2:00 PM. Check-out: 12:00 noon.
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 95418 98817
- Email: info@defoy.in
- Booking: Direct via WhatsApp enquiry. No OTAs.

## Rooms

1. Premium Room with Balcony — 25 rooms — from INR 5,000 per night. King bed, sleeps 2, extra bed available, private balcony, breakfast included, Wi-Fi, room service.
2. Attic Room — fourth floor, closest to the roof. King bed, warm timber panelling, private balcony, breakfast included.

## Experiences

- Bonfire evenings on the lawn.
- Valley walks at your own pace.
- Pahalgam sightseeing: Aru, Betaab, Chandanwari.
- Photography across the timber facade and mountain views.
- Family moments on spacious lawns.
- Quiet luxury: warm bedding, hot tea, attentive staff.

## Policies

- Check-in: 2:00 PM. Check-out: 12:00 noon.
- Early check-in and late check-out subject to availability.
- Rates confirmed at time of booking.
- A valid government photo ID required at check-in. Foreign nationals need passport and visa.
- Policy queries, GST and invoices: info@defoy.in.

## Getting there

Srinagar Airport is approximately 95 km away, about 2.5 to 3 hours by road.
